description.text: One of the two fourth expansions of the Sun & Moon series, released together with Ultradimensional Beasts on 15 September 2017, in which the Ultra Beasts arrived as Pokémon-GX; their GX attacks sit in a red frame instead of blue. Awakened Heroes holds Buzzwole-GX and Kartana-GX, and Silvally made its card debut here as Silvally-GX, with Alolan Golem-GX. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 50, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX and Gladion, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Counter Catcher, Warp Energy and Metal Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Crimson Invasion in November 2017.
